text:
lina (sre): starting follow-up — intermittent cross-region TLS handshake failures and 502s observed during morning window (us-west -> eu-west). opening thread to capture actions and ownership.

infra-bot: alert: high_5xx_rate on /v1/respond at 2026-04-10T09:14:00Z · p95=860ms incident=inc-20260410-07

aaron (networking): quick triage: seen short NAT port churn + a few route-manager leader changes overlapping the window. suspect small window where SNI hits instance with stale cert.

dev (eng-runtime): logs show TLS alert 40 and "unknown certificate" entries. also saw increased connection resets from egress proxies.

lina (sre): repro for infra: run a tight curl loop in us-west to try reproduce the handshakes:
```
for i in {1..500}; do curl -sS -H 'Host: api.redwood.internal' https://api.redwood.internal/health || echo fail:$i; done
```

aaron (networking): Action A1: capture 20m tcpdump on egress-gw-us-west-1 (port 443). owner: aaron. ETA: 2026-04-10 12:00 UTC.

dev (eng-runtime): Action A2 (mitigation): roll 500ms transient backoff and enable short session stickiness for cross-region routes for 4h. owner: dev. ETA: 2026-04-10 10:30 UTC.

lina (sre): Action A3: add lightweight TLS fields to proxy spans (SNI, cert_cn, route_instance) for 72h to aid RCA. owner: lina. ETA: 2026-04-11 09:00 UTC.

cloud-eng: Action A4: open provider case requesting NAT port counters and AS-path traces for egress regions around window. owner: cloud-eng. ETA: 2026-04-14 18:00 UTC.

maya (product): Action A5: prepare short customer note and support playbook for any impacted tenants. owner: maya. ETA: 2026-04-10 17:00 UTC.

aaron (networking): uploaded small pcap and short notes — saw same client IP hit two different backend cert CNs within ~25s in one trace. link in thread.

dev (eng-runtime): deployed mitigation toggle to 30% -> monitoring errors. will post PR link once 100% done.

lina (sre): created dashboard metric tls.handshake.crossregion and set alert at 12/min. scheduling sync 2026-04-10 15:00 UTC to review captures and provider reply. marking this thread as canonical follow-up. ping me for blockers. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: incident state -> mitigated (2026-04-10 11:05 UTC)
